summary: Create a directory synchronously, preserving recursive return value, existing-path errors, and mode semantics.

requirements.options_shape: statically known or represented by NodeFsOptions

semantics.return_value: undefined normally; with recursive:true, first directory path created or undefined

caveats: Directory.CreateDirectory alone loses the recursive:true return value.
With recursive:false, an existing directory is an error; .NET CreateDirectory is idempotent.
Windows root and permission semantics differ from POSIX.

tests.name: nonrecursive existing directory throws
tests.expected_behavior: second call throws a Node-compatible EEXIST-style error

tests.name: recursive returns first created path
tests.expected_behavior: returns the first directory path that had to be created, or undefined if none were created
